Error: Unsupported block type

  on main.xcl line 4, in variable.name, field timeout[0]:
     2 |   default = "a<b"
     3 | 
     4 |   timeout "http" {
     5 |     connect = 30
     6 |   }

Blocks of type "timeout" are not expected here. A variable takes only default, description, type and sensitive, so move the timeout to the resource that uses it.

Warning: Deprecated attribute

retries is deprecated, use a retry block.
